pages.title: Earned Treasures
pages.text: A universal boss crate draws from that boss's combined equipment pool. Materials and ordinary trophies are retained separately.$(br2)Aether dungeon rewards use earned treasure chests. Twilight and supported Cataclysm bosses have their own pools.

pages.title: Signature Affixes
pages.text: Compatible boss equipment can carry one of six signature themes: Emberbrand, Frostbound, Stormheart, Venomfang, Voidmarked or Stoneguard.$(br2)Their combat effects complement the normal affixes. Native rewards that cannot support them retain their own powers.
